purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: Among adults with type 2 diabetes, please calculate the average of each person’s most recent glycated haemoglobin result, expressed in percent, together with how many people actually had a result.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Type 2 diabetes means a condition code beginning E11.
Use the last observation on or before the reference date with LOINC 4548-4; do not average all visits.
Overall results only, one decimal for the mean; metrics: hba1c_measured and hba1c_mean.
